items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: I'll tell you who they had, this boy would die, and they climbed the sax. Henry.

ctx.x: Yeah. Willoughbend. Yeah. Pajon, they played with their boys. They didn't play too long, and I'll tell you who they had, this boy would die, and they climbed the sax. Henry. Henry. From your line of your way. Henry. You remember him? Yeah. Henry Julian. behind behind Pajer and him. See? Pajer and him. We stayed there. How long did he stay about two years? He stayed there. We closed out with him. With the man.
I was gonna ask you about the advertising job. You say you played advertising jobs. Who did you play? What band did you play with?
